children: Copper prices have been hitting new highs in recent weeks, thanks largely to increased demand due to the AI infrastructure buildout and concerns about potential U.S. tariffs on certain copper products.
what they thought was the best copper mining stock play right now for investors.
: The two purest-play copper mining stocks that move with the metal's price are Freeport-McMoRan
FCX and SCCO are likely to continue leveraging copper gains, but they may underperform the metal during downside corrections.
Copper has been in a bullish trend since 2001. It has seen new highs and corrections for years. I view this week's downdraft as nothing out of the ordinary for this volatile market.
(Andrew Hecht also runs the SA investing group The Hecht Commodity Report.)

Zoltan Ban: First off, I want to emphasize that I am of the view that we are on the cusp of a demand-destruction event as energy prices rise, leading to interest rates rising in correlation due to inflation risk. Copper prices may therefore take a break from the current long-term fundamentals-based rally.
The AI buildout, as well as the continued rise in EV sales, makes for a strong long-term case for copper prices to continue rising beyond what may be a short-term dip. I have BHP
on my watchlist for a better buying opportunity. Half of its revenues come from copper.
I have also been investing in Barrick

, which is a gold miner, with an eye on the long-term benefits of its rising copper output, particularly as its Pakistan gold-copper project is set to be commissioned and start ramping up output in the next few years. The Reko Diq project is currently on hold due to security issues in the area; however, it carries great potential, especially if one believes in the long-term fundamentals driving the copper market.
If I am correct and copper prices will dip in the next few months as energy prices and interest rates continue to rise, it may be a good buying opportunity.
